title: Round Up to a Power of Two

forbidden.message: no loops or generate blocks: use the bit-smearing trick
no $clog2, $countones or ** — derive it with shifts and ORs

constraints: `y` is the smallest power of two that is ≥ `x`.
`x = 0` gives `y = 1`. `x` above 32768 gives `y = 65536`, which is why `y` has 17 bits.
hints: If you could set every bit below the most significant 1, adding 1 would give the next power of two.
`v | (v >> 1)`, then `| (v >> 2)`, `| (v >> 4)`, `| (v >> 8)` smears the top bit all the way down.
Start from `x - 1` so that exact powers of two map to themselves, and handle `x = 0` separately.
